deploy-bot: Deploy initiated for environment `staging`

maria: Watching latency & error dashboards. QA standby for quick handoff.

maria: saw the same 500s, looking into stacktrace now. holding any further traffic increases. :pause_button:
alex: Acknowledged hold. Does this look like bad model load or infra flake?
ops-oncall: If we can't isolate quickly, prefer rollback to previous tag. rollback playbook ready.
maria: stacktrace points to NPE during model preload in reranker container. probable regression in model wrapper. hotfix branch `hotfix/rerank-preload` being built (est ~12m).
samir: Given the change window and production-like risk, +1 to rollback.
alex: OK, initiating rollback to `release/rc-4.0.9` to restore full staging traffic.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated. pin -> `release/rc-4.0.9`. shifting traffic back to prior variant.
deploy-bot: Commands executed:
```
kubectl -n staging set image deploy/rerank service=repo:release-rc-4.0.9
kubectl rollout status deploy/rerank -n staging
```
deploy-bot: Rollback in progress — healthchecks monitored. ETA ~3m.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. staging now pinned to `release/rc-4.0.9`. healthchecks green. :white_check_mark:
maria: Nice. Opening follow-up: jira INF-4123 for hotfix + safer preload check.
qa-bot: Will re-run reranker smoke after hotfix deployed.
alex: Thanks all — marking this deploy as rolled back and closing this thread. Will reattempt hotfix deploy outside change window if needed. :lock:
